## Episode Thesis

This macro-strategy episode argues that the economy and stock markets have held up well despite geopolitical turmoil, a Strait of Hormuz scare and renewed inflation fears. It points to Q2 earnings growth, the strongest since the pandemic, as a major sign of strength. The guest is cautiously optimistic on equities but calls rising US long-term yields, with the 10-year near 5% on debt and deficit worries, a big dark cloud. The episode also covers Fed and Riksbank hike pricing, which it calls stretched beyond 100bp for Sweden, the weak krona pushing Swedish savers towards global funds, and a recommendation to hold a well-diversified long-term portfolio.
